nodes.description: External caller address used as depositor, withdrawer, claimant and access-control subject.
Governance multisig address controlling privileged setters and rescue.
Block at which STACK emissions end; gates deposit and governs kick math.
Tokens emitted per block, used by _kick to accrue rewards.
Total shares deposited in the gauge.
Global accumulator of reward tokens per shares scaled by 1e18.
Last block at which the distribution ran.
Mapping address to DepositState (userShares, tokensAccrued) per user.
Rebase token accepted for deposits and withdrawals.
STACK DAO reward token distributed to users.
Governance-only function updating the governance address.
Governance-only function that kicks and updates emissionRate.
Governance-only function extending the emission endBlock.
nonReentrant external deposit that pulls acceptToken and mints shares.
nonReentrant external withdraw that burns shares and transfers acceptToken.
nonReentrant external entrypoint delegating to _claimSTACK for msg.sender.
Internal reward claim that kicks accrual and transfers STACK to the user.
Internal accrual routine advancing lastBlock and tokensAccrued.
Governance-only nonReentrant rescue of stuck tokens or ETH.
Returns underlying value of a user's shares via acceptToken.
Returns underlying value of total depositedShares via acceptToken.
IERC20(STACK).safeTransfer(_user, _tokensGive) external token transfer inside _claimSTACK.
IERC20(acceptToken).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount) external token transfer inside withdraw.
IERC20(acceptToken).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount) external call inside deposit.
governance.transfer(_amount) raw ETH transfer inside rescue.
IERC20(_token).safeTransfer(governance, _amount) external token transfer inside rescue.
_new address parameter of setGovernance.
_new rate parameter of setEmissionRate.
_block parameter of setEndBlock.
_amount underlying parameter of deposit.
_amount underlying parameter of withdraw.
_user parameter of _claimSTACK.
_token parameter of rescue.
_amount parameter of rescue.
_state DepositState memory copy in deposit.
_sharesFor computed shares in deposit.
_state DepositState memory copy in withdraw.
_sharesFor computed shares in withdraw.
_state DepositState memory copy in _claimSTACK.
_tokensGive amount of STACK to transfer in _claimSTACK.
_deltaBlock block delta computed in _kick.
_tokensToAccrue emission delta computed in _kick.
_totalDeposited cached depositedShares in _kick.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the depositor whose shares are credited in deposit.
msg.sender is the withdrawer whose shares are debited in withdraw.
msg.sender is passed as _user into _claimSTACK from deposit/withdraw.
msg.sender must equal governance in setGovernance access check.
msg.sender must equal governance in setEmissionRate access check.
msg.sender must equal governance in setEndBlock access check.
msg.sender must equal governance in rescue access check.
msg.sender is the recipient of the acceptToken transfer in withdraw.
governance state variable is read for the setGovernance authorization check.
governance state variable is read for the setEmissionRate authorization check.
governance state variable is read for the setEndBlock authorization check.
governance state variable is read for the rescue authorization check and as transfer target.
setGovernance writes the new governance address into storage.
setEmissionRate writes the new emissionRate value.
setEndBlock writes the new endBlock value.
deposit reads endBlock to require block.number <= endBlock.
deposit writes the updated DepositState back into shares[msg.sender].
deposit increases depositedShares by _sharesFor.
deposit reads acceptToken for safeTransferFrom and getSharesForUnderlying.
deposit invokes the external safeTransferFrom call on acceptToken.
deposit calls _claimSTACK(msg.sender) before pulling funds.
withdraw calls _claimSTACK(msg.sender) before burning shares.
claimSTACK delegates reward claiming to _claimSTACK.
withdraw writes the reduced DepositState back into shares[msg.sender].
withdraw decreases depositedShares by _sharesFor.
withdraw reads acceptToken for getSharesForUnderlying and safeTransfer.
withdraw invokes the external safeTransfer of acceptToken to msg.sender.
withdraw _amount parameter flows into the transferred token amount.
_claimSTACK calls _kick to bring accrual up to the current block.
_claimSTACK writes the synchronized DepositState back into shares[_user].
_claimSTACK stores the global tokensAccrued checkpoint into the user state.
_claimSTACK reads tokensAccrued to compute the user's accrual delta.
_claimSTACK invokes the external STACK safeTransfer to the user.
_tokensGive local computed value flows into the STACK safeTransfer amount.
_user parameter flows into the STACK safeTransfer recipient.
_claimSTACK reads STACK token for balanceOf check and safeTransfer.
_kick reads depositedShares into _totalDeposited for scaling.
_kick reads emissionRate to compute accrued tokens.
_kick reads endBlock to clamp the block delta.
_kick accumulates tokensAccrued from _tokensToAccrue.
_kick writes lastBlock = block.number after accrual.
_kick reads lastBlock to compute the block delta.
safeTransferFrom invokes the acceptToken contract which may reenter deposit before shares are written.
safeTransfer invokes the acceptToken contract which may reenter withdraw.
STACK safeTransfer invokes an external token which may reenter _claimSTACK.
governance.transfer forwards ETH with all gas allowing a contract governance to reenter rescue.
rescue safeTransfer invokes the arbitrary _token contract which may reenter.
rescue performs a raw ETH transfer to governance.
rescue performs an external safeTransfer of the given token to governance.
balanceOf reads acceptToken to convert shares to underlying.
balanceOf reads the user's DepositState from shares.
totalSupply reads acceptToken to convert total shares to underlying.
totalSupply reads depositedShares for the underlying conversion.
_new parameter is consumed by setGovernance body.
_new rate parameter is consumed by setEmissionRate body.
_block parameter is consumed by setEndBlock body.
_amount parameter is consumed by deposit body.
_user parameter is consumed by _claimSTACK body.
_token parameter is consumed by rescue body.
_amount parameter is consumed by rescue body.
deposit defines the _state local DepositState.
deposit defines the _sharesFor local.
withdraw defines the _state local DepositState.
withdraw defines the _sharesFor local.
_claimSTACK defines the _state local DepositState.
_claimSTACK defines the _tokensGive local.
_kick defines the _deltaBlock local.
_kick defines the _tokensToAccrue local.
_kick defines the _totalDeposited local.
